column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=Map of part of a large city in Spain, Barcelona, recognized by a famous monument named, in the center and slightly north of the map: the Sagrada Familia.
#Text=In the northeast corner of the map, part of the port basins can be seen.
#Text=Three major roads run from south to northeast, i.e., toward the center of Barcelona and the port area.
#Text=Another major road, like a ring road, surrounds the city center.
#Text=Two railway lines arrive, one from the south and the other from the east, at a station located in the heart of the city.
#Text=Famous monuments and city districts are named.
#Text=To the west and south of the map, beyond the main road/ring road, there are a few undeveloped green areas with some indications of relief on the peaks (144 m, 137 m).
#Text=To the far west is a huge Repsol A Coruña refinery.
